recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)  
**Order Date:** March 10, 2025  
**Provider:** Dr. S. Mehta

---

Your prior authorization request for continuous glucose monitoring has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**Diabetes Diagnosis:** Confirmed. Patient has active diabetes mellitus with recent HbA1c of 6.2% (February 16, 2025) and documented diabetes management.

**Medical Necessity:** Confirmed. Patient is on insulin therapy—insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime (initiated May 12, 2024, currently active)—which meets medical necessity requirements for CGM.

**Recent Evaluation:** Confirmed. Diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. S. Mehta on January 14, 2025 (within 6-month requirement) documented review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

The patient meets all coverage criteria for CGM. Authorization is valid for one year from the order date. Please submit claims with this authorization reference.
